cards.lore: Recognizes PAMPs (microbes, e.g., flagellin via TLR5) and DAMPs (sterile danger signals). Triggers NF-kB signaling to initiate pro-inflammatory cytokine production.
cards.gradeReason: Named role clear, but NF-kB lore wall explains instead of invites performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Cartoon grotesque. Subject: Worm with binoculars scanning bacterial flags on pie crust. Mood: Alert paranoia.

cards.lore: Arrives first via IL-8. Uses NADPH oxidase to make superoxide (HOCl). CGD patients lack this enzyme, suffering recurrent catalase-positive infections.
cards.gradeReason: "First Responder" + "Oxidative Burst" — you know exactly who to be and what to do.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Emergency action comic. Subject: Neutrophil firefighter sprinting into bacterial chaos spraying HOCl. Mood: Explosive urgency.

cards.lore: M1 (IFN-γ-activated): kills pathogens with ROS, M2 (IL-4/IL-13-activated): promotes healing and fibrosis. Presents antigens on MHC II to CD4+ T cells.
cards.gradeReason: Two-state mechanic is playable but M1/M2 jargon needs context to perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dual-persona portrait. Subject: Bear macrophage split between rage-mode and healing-mode with MHC II badge. Mood: Controlled duality.

cards.lore: The most powerful APC. Can uniquely present exogenous viral antigens on MHC I to prime naive CD8+ T cells in the lymph node.
cards.gradeReason: "The Bridge" is clear but cross-presentation MHC I/II mechanic is dense for newcomers.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Cosmic connector. Subject: Octopus-like APC bridging innate and adaptive realms in lymph node. Mood: Mysterious authority.

cards.lore: Kills virally infected or tumor cells that downregulate MHC I to hide from T cells. Uses perforin/granzyme. Performs ADCC via CD16.
cards.gradeReason: Kills cells hiding from T cells — instantly embody the immune hitman with no briefing.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Noir assassin. Subject: Bat-winged cell hunter stalking MHC-I-deficient tumor targets. Mood: Cold precision.

cards.lore: Classical, Lectin, and Alternative pathways converge on C3b opsonization and C5b-9 (MAC lysis). Regulated by CD55 (DAF) and CD59.
cards.gradeReason: "Unstoppable Cascade" from three lanes — domino metaphor plays itself at the table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Domino action cartoon. Subject: Three-headed centipede triggering chain destruction ending in MAC pore. Mood: Inevitable momentum.

cards.lore: The alarm signals. C3a strongly attracts neutrophils and triggers mast cells. In sepsis, massive C5a causes simultaneous inflammation and neutrophil immunosuppression.
cards.gradeReason: Power says what to do — "Panic" then "Chaos." Two acts, perfectly scripted.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Alarm-cartoon escalation. Subject: Monkey throwing panic grenades at mast cells while C5a tornado forms. Mood: Escalating panic.

cards.lore: Triggered by viral nucleic acids. Signals via JAK-STAT to upregulate PKR (blocks viral translation) and increase MHC I expression on adjacent cells.
cards.gradeReason: "Early Warning" role is clear but JAK-STAT-PKR-MHC I chain is explaining not inviting.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Cartoon broadcast tower. Subject: Parrot sounding cGAS-STING alarm across cellular neighborhood. Mood: Alert broadcast.

cards.lore: Vasodilation (histamine) → Permeability (bradykinin) → Diapedesis (selectins/integrins). Resolves via IL-10/TGF-β or progresses to chronic fibrosis.
cards.gradeReason: Five cardinal signs on the card — quiz mechanic built in, perform each one at the table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Five-headed fire-and-water explosion. Subject: Dragon manifesting redness/heat/swelling/pain/loss of function simultaneously. Mood: Orchestrated mayhem.

cards.lore: Built by macrophages + Th1 cells (IFN-γ) when acute clearance fails. Anti-TNF therapy (infliximab) destroys the wall, risking fatal reactivation of latent Tb.
cards.gradeReason: "Walled Garden" grandma locking away what she can't kill — total character, zero explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Cozy horror. Subject: Grandmother tortoise building fortified stone wall around sleeping TB bacteria. Mood: Deceptive warmth.

cards.lore: Signal 1 = TCR + MHC. Signal 2 = Co-stimulation (CD28 + CD80/86). Without Signal 2, the T cell enters anergy (permanent shutdown).
cards.gradeReason: Two-signal mechanic is clean but the anergy-as-shutdown consequence needs prior context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Security checkpoint cartoon. Subject: Bulldog T cell demanding two ID badges before activating or shutting down forever. Mood: Cautious bureaucracy.

cards.lore: Fights intracellular pathogens. Secretes IFN-γ to supercharge macrophages and upregulate MHC II. Drives delayed-type hypersensitivity and autoimmune tissue damage.
cards.gradeReason: "Macrophage Recruitment" is a role but IFN-γ supercharge landing needs IL-12 upstream context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Military commander cartoon. Subject: Bulldog general rallying macrophage troops with IFN-γ bullhorn. Mood: Grim determination.

cards.lore: Driven by IL-4. Secretes IL-4 (IgE class switch), IL-5 (eosinophil activation), and IL-13. The primary driver of Type I hypersensitivity (allergy/asthma).
cards.gradeReason: "Parasite Purge" is a role but cytokine alphabet needs prior taxonomy to land cold.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Pastoral action cartoon. Subject: Shepherd girl summoning eosinophil worm-hunters via IL-5 signal. Mood: Sweet but pathologically dangerous.

cards.lore: Suppresses immunity via IL-10, TGF-β, and CTLA-4 contact. FoxP3 mutation causes IPEX syndrome (lethal multi-organ autoimmunity in infant boys).
cards.gradeReason: "Peacekeeper" who stops civil war — instantly who you are and what you do at the table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Calm authoritarian diplomat. Subject: Sloth general in blue beret separating fighting immune cells with CTLA-4 shield. Mood: Restrained dominance.

cards.lore: AID enzyme alters heavy chains. T-cell help (CD40L) is required for memory and switching. BTK mutation causes X-linked agammaglobulinemia (no mature B cells).
cards.gradeReason: "Class Switch" mechanic is solid but AID/BTK consequence chain needs background to perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Costume-change anime. Subject: Beaver B cell swapping armor types from IgM to IgG to IgA via AID. Mood: Adaptive elegance.

cards.lore: IgM (pentamer, immediate complement activator), IgG (most abundant, crosses placenta), IgA (dimer, mucosal), IgE (mast cell bound, allergies).
cards.gradeReason: "5 Modular Outfits" is fun but four isotype rules make it reference card over performance card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Modular suit showcase. Subject: Chameleon immunoglobulin in five different armor outfits on rotating stand. Mood: Professional versatility.

cards.lore: Recognizes antigens on MHC I. Kills via perforin (pores) + granzyme B (apoptosis). PD-1/PD-L1 checkpoint exhaustion in tumors.
cards.gradeReason: Sniper with a punch — "Perforin Punch" tells you the move the moment you read it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Assassin action comic. Subject: CD8+ sniper cell punching holes in MHC-I-displaying tumor cells. Mood: Precise lethal efficiency.

cards.lore: Lower activation threshold, larger clone size, and tissue-resident persistence (TRM cells). Basis of vaccine immunity and the germinal center reaction.
cards.gradeReason: Elephant memory metaphor + "Rapid Recall" — pure performance, zero explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Military veteran portrait. Subject: Elephant soldier in filing room instantly recognizing old enemy pathogen. Mood: Confident battle readiness.

cards.lore: IL-8: neutrophil by NLRP3 inflammasome. IL-6 drives CRP in liver, elevated in COVID-19. TNF-α drives cachexia and sepsis. Suppressed by IL-10.
cards.gradeReason: "Escalation" lands but three-cytokine alphabet tour is encyclopedic not theatrical.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Alarm cascade cartoon. Subject: Messenger bird chain-launching escalating cytokine alerts toward liver and blood. Mood: Mounting urgency.

cards.lore: Uncontrolled IL-6, IFN-γ, macrophage amplification. In primary HLH, missing lymphocyte perforin prevents CTLs from shutting off the loop.
cards.gradeReason: "Hyperferritinemic Rampage" — you're a bear in a tornado. Absolute theater.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Disaster rampage. Subject: Manic bear-twister destroying everything in unstoppable cytokine feedback loop. Mood: Catastrophic frenzy.

cards.lore: I: Immediate IgE. II: Antibody-mediated surface cytotoxicity. III: Soluble immune complex depositing in tissues. IV: Delayed cell-activated (48-72h).
cards.gradeReason: Four-mischief taxonomy is memorable but needs prior exposure to fire each mechanism cold.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Taxonomist portrait duo. Subject: Two owl scholars cataloguing four types of immune sabotage in leather journals. Mood: Dry academic menace.

cards.lore: Allergen cross-links IgE on mast cells. Preformed histamine causes immediate vasodilation/bronchoconstriction. Epinephrine 1:1000 IM is the only first-line rescue (reverses shock via α1/β1/β2).
cards.gradeReason: Epinephrine dose right on card — embody mast cell and ER nurse simultaneously.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Emergency explosion comic. Subject: Hedgehog mast cell erupting histamine at cross-linked IgE antenna. Mood: Immediate life-or-death urgency.

cards.lore: Antibodies attack specific cell surfaces. Causes Goodpasture's (anti-GBM), Autoimmune Hemolytic Anemia, and Myasthenia Gravis (receptor blockade without direct lysis).
cards.gradeReason: "Friendly Fire" — you know instantly the antibody shot the wrong target. No further coaching.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Battlefield tragedy. Subject: Antibody sniper accidentally shooting own red blood cell through scope. Mood: Tragic friendly fire.

cards.lore: IgG complexes form in blood during antigen excess. They deposit in small vessels (glomeruli, synovium) = complement activation + neutrophil destruction (e.g., SLE, Serum Sickness).
cards.gradeReason: "Glomerular Trap" is vivid but antigen-excess deposition chain needs SLE context first.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Plumbing disaster cartoon. Subject: Antibody-antigen clusters clogging glomerular pipes triggering complement demolition crew. Mood: Slow catastrophic accumulation.

cards.lore: Cell-mediated, no antibodies! CD4+ Th1 cells recognize antigen, secrete IFN-γ, and activate macrophages. Drives contact dermatitis, tuberculin skin test, and Type 1 Diabetes.
cards.gradeReason: "48-72 Hour Peak" timing mechanic is clever; "Grudge" character is solid but lore is heavy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Slow-burn revenge cartoon. Subject: Snail Th1 cell holding grudge, arriving 48 hours late fully armed. Mood: Delayed inevitability.

cards.lore: Epithelial defect → Th2 dominance (IL-4/IL-5/IL-13). Allergen immunotherapy desensitizes by shifting the response from Th2 to Treg and inducing IgG4 blocking antibodies.
cards.gradeReason: "Allergic March" performs if you know the clinical term; bewildering if you don't.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Parade-gone-wrong cartoon. Subject: Skunk leading eczema-to-asthma march through body with IL-4 banner. Mood: Unstoppable allergic progression.

cards.lore: Activation releases preformed histamine (minutes). Newly synthesized leukotrienes (hours later) cause bronchoconstriction 1000x more potent than histamine. Blocked by montelukast.
cards.gradeReason: Two-wave mechanic is teachable but "Leukotriene Sustenance" doesn't grab performers cold.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Two-stage bomb cartoon. Subject: Mast cell detonating histamine now, leukotrienes later in sustained bronchial assault. Mood: Staggered detonation.

cards.lore: Releases Major Basic Protein (MBP) to kill helminths. Driven by IL-5 (Blocked therapeutically by mepolizumab). Causes tissue remodeling in asthma and Hypereosinophilic Syndrome.
cards.gradeReason: "Toxicity" mechanic is clear but MBP/IL-5/HES triple-tag buries the performance cue.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Tropical pest exterminator. Subject: Pink cobra spraying Major Basic Protein venom at helminth parasites. Mood: Toxic specialist efficiency.

cards.lore: Defective apoptotic cell clearance exposes nuclear antigens. TLR9/TLR7 activate Type I IFN and autoantibody production. Treat all patients with hydroxychloroquine.
cards.gradeReason: "Great Imitator" — classic identity. You ARE the disease that looks like everything else.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Disguise-master portrait. Subject: Fox in butterfly-rash mask mimicking seventeen different diseases. Mood: Theatrical deception.

cards.lore: Synovial inflammation drives invasive pannus formation → cartilage/bone erosion. Anti-CCP antibodies (ACPA) are highly specific. Synovial fluid is neutrophil-rich with low glucose.
cards.gradeReason: "Pannus Invasion" is a solid action but pannus-concept needs prior anatomy grounding.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Gothic military invasion. Subject: Synovial tissue general eroding joint cartilage castle under HLA-DR4 banner. Mood: Relentless joint erosion.

cards.lore: Lymphocytic infiltration destroys salivary/lacrimal glands (anti-Ro/SSA, anti-La/SSB). Causes extreme xerostomia/dry eyes, and can cause Type 1 Renal Tubular Acidosis.
cards.gradeReason: "Glandular Drought" — perform the desert mouth, the sandy eyes. Completely vivid.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Desert disaster portrait. Subject: Camel with cracked salivary glands and dry tear ducts in parched landscape. Mood: Arid glandular devastation.

cards.lore: Endothelial injury → Raynaud's → TGF-β driven fibrosis. Diffuse (anti-Scl-70, early ILD) vs. Limited (anti-centromere). Renal crisis MUST be treated with ACE inhibitors despite AKI.
cards.gradeReason: "Fibrosis Architecture" is evocative but Diffuse/Limited antibody split needs prior mnemonics.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Armadillo fortress portrait. Subject: Armored armadillo building fibrotic skin walls over Raynaud's color-changing landscape. Mood: Rigid systemic entrapment.

cards.lore: Polymyositis: CD8+ CTLs destroy muscle expressing aberrant MHC I. Dermatomyositis: Type I IFN drives microangiopathy (Gottron's papules, heliotrope rash). Anti-Jo-1 = antisynthetase syndrome.
cards.gradeReason: "Friendly Fire" callback is solid but poly vs. dermato diagnostic split needs a key.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Self-destruction action. Subject: Honey badger CTL attacking own muscle fibers with heliotrope rash markings. Mood: Painful autoimmune self-attack.

cards.lore: Large (Giant Cell Arteritis = blindness risk, immediate steroids). Medium (PAN, Kawasaki). Small (ANCA-associated: GPA/Wegener's = PR3; MPA = MPO).
cards.gradeReason: Three-tier caliber sorting is logical but GPA/MPA acronym wall defeats cold performers.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Anatomical pipe diagram. Subject: Snake threading through large/medium/small vessels with targeted inflammatory damage. Mood: Infrastructure assault.

cards.lore: HLA-B27 misfolding triggers the IL-23/IL-17 axis. Causes AS, Psoriatic, Reactive (can't see, pee, climb a tree), and IBD-arthritis. Sacroiliitis and enthesitis are hallmarks.
cards.gradeReason: "Can't see, pee, climb a tree" mnemonic — you'll never forget it or stop performing it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Mnemonic comedy. Subject: Chameleon unable to see, pee, or climb a bent-spine bamboo. Mood: Absurdist educational theater.

cards.lore: Hashimoto's: Th1-mediated destruction → hypothyroidism. Graves' IgG mimics TSH, continually activating the receptor → hyperthyroidism and proptosis (orbital fibroblasts express TSH-R).
cards.gradeReason: Graves vs Hashimoto duality works but TSH-R/proptosis mechanism is explanation not invitation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Jekyll-and-Hyde portrait. Subject: Bird split between sluggish hypothyroid and bulging-eyed hyperthyroid extremes. Mood: Hormonal dramatic contrast.

cards.lore: CD8+ T cell-mediated destruction of beta cells. Anti-GAD65/IA-2 are markers, not the pathogenic drivers. Teplizumab (anti-CD3) can delay clinical onset in high-risk patients.
cards.gradeReason: "Honeymoon Illusion" — perform the false calm before the beta-cell crash. Brilliant framing.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Bittersweet romance tragedy. Subject: Bee in tuxedo destroying honeycomb pancreas while smiling at false plateau. Mood: Deceptive sweetness.

cards.lore: IgG antibodies directly attack the GBM/alveolar membrane. Causes pulmonary hemorrhage + Rapidly Progressive GN. Immunofluorescence shows smooth, LINEAR IgG deposition.
cards.gradeReason: "Linear IF Strike" is precise but requires knowing IF pattern distinction — G2 for pre-context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Direct strike cartoon. Subject: Mole antibody hammering straight linear lines across kidney basement membrane. Mood: Relentless linear assault.

cards.lore: Complete failure of T-cell development (and often B/NK cells). Fatal if given live vaccines (e.g., BCG-fatal). Maternal T-cells crossing the placenta can cause fatal GVHD in the infant.
cards.gradeReason: "Complete Void" is performable but BCG-fatal/GVHD warnings are safety lore, not character beats.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Empty void portrait. Subject: Penguin chick in sterile bubble with zero immune cells to deploy. Mood: Defenseless isolation.

cards.lore: Pro-B fails to transition to pre-B. No mature B cells, no tonsils, no germinal centers. Highly susceptible to encapsulated bacteria (pneumococcus, H. influenzae) after maternal IgG fades at 6 months.
cards.gradeReason: "Encapsulated Vulnerability" is precise but the 6-month maternal IgG fade is lore not action.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Sad vulnerability cartoon. Subject: Hatching penguin without antibody shield facing armored pneumococcus at 6 months. Mood: Defenseless exposure.

cards.lore: Normal B-cell numbers but defective antibody production (low IgG/IgA). Paradoxically presents with recurrent sinopulmonary infections, severe autoimmunity (cytopenias), and highly increased lymphoma risk.
cards.gradeReason: "Late-Onset Failure" + paradox framing is clever but triple-threat presentation needs guidance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Late-blooming failure portrait. Subject: Ostrich with full B-cell army that forgot to manufacture antibody bullets. Mood: Baffling inadequacy.

cards.lore: MAC deficiency (C5-C9) specifically predisposes to meningococcal/gonococcal infections. C1-INH deficiency causes bradykinin-driven hereditary angioedema (unresponsive to epinephrine).
cards.gradeReason: One deficiency, one pathogen, one mnemonic. Textbook G1.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Bullseye targeting. Subject: Broken complement chain with Neisseria freely dancing through the C5-C9 gap. Mood: Precise predatory vulnerability.

cards.lore: Hyperacute rejection is driven by preformed donor-specific antibodies (prevented by crossmatching). GVHD occurs when donor T-cells attack recipient tissues (skin, gut, liver).
cards.gradeReason: "Betrayal" framing is theatrical but hyperacute/acute/chronic timeline needs scaffolding.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Double-cross thriller. Subject: Donor T cell turning on recipient skin, gut, and liver after inside job. Mood: Calculated insider betrayal.

cards.lore: Bind cyclophilin/FKBP12 → inhibit calcineurin → block NFAT dephosphorylation → prevent IL-2 transcription. Highly nephrotoxic (afferent arteriolar constriction).
cards.gradeReason: Chain mechanism is logical but cyclophilin-FKBP-calcineurin-NFAT cascade is memorize not perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Molecular lock-and-key cartoon. Subject: Frog with wrench jamming calcineurin gear to silence IL-2 transcription. Mood: Surgical suppression.

cards.lore: Binds FKBP12 to inhibit mTOR. Blocks IL-2-driven T-cell proliferation (not production). Non-nephrotoxic. Impairs wound healing, used post-transplant and for CAR-[T].
cards.gradeReason: "Barricade" is actionable but mTOR/FKBP12 disambiguation from Tacrolimus needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Roadblock action. Subject: Rhinoceros stop-sign blocking G1-to-S cell cycle checkpoint non-nephrotoxically. Mood: Immovable proliferation obstruction.

cards.lore: Inhibits inosine monophosphate dehydrogenase (IMPDH). Selectively starves T and B cells, which uniquely rely entirely on de novo purine synthesis and lack a salvage pathway. Teratogenic.
cards.gradeReason: "De Novo Starvation" is memorable but IMPDH selectivity logic needs prior purine-path context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Famine strategy cartoon. Subject: Vulture cutting off lymphocyte purine supply line while leaving other cells unharmed. Mood: Cold metabolic siege.

cards.lore: Blocks TNF-α signaling. Highly effective for RA and IBD. Because TNF maintains granulomas, blockade risks fatal reactivation of latent TB. (Etanercept is a decoy receptor, fails in IBD).
cards.gradeReason: "Granuloma Breaker" is vivid but TB-reactivation risk requires Granny Granuloma context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Alliance action cartoon. Subject: Dragon duo smashing TNF wall but cracking open Granny's latent TB vault. Mood: Powerful with hidden catastrophic risk.

cards.lore: Anti-CTLA-4 (Ipilimumab) and anti-PD-1 (pembrolizumab) remove inhibitory brakes on T-cells to fight tumors. Causes severe immune-related adverse events (irAEs) like colitis and pneumonitis.
cards.gradeReason: "Brake Release" — pull the handbrake off, watch the immune system destroy tumors and everything else.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Race car sabotage. Subject: T cell with cut brakes racing full speed toward tumor, destroying colitis bystanders. Mood: Reckless liberation.

cards.lore: Blocks intracellular JAK-STAT signaling, silencing dozens of cytokine signals simultaneously. Causes high risk of Varicella Zoster (shingles) reactivation—check immunity before starting.
cards.gradeReason: "Silence" metaphor is strong but silencing "dozens of signals" is abstract without a target.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Signal-jamming cartoon. Subject: Beaver damming intracellular cytokine river while shingles virus sneaks through unguarded. Mood: Broad suppression with hidden cost.

cards.lore: IL-17 (from Th17) drives psoriasis and ankylosing spondylitis (axSpA). Anti-IL-17A is effective in skin/joints but worsens Inflammatory Bowel Disease because IL-17 is protective in the GI mucosa.
cards.gradeReason: "Bodyguard" role and "Worsens IBD" warning creates dual-identity needing two separate contexts.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dual-role bodyguard. Subject: Dinosaur guard protecting skin and spine but inadvertently attacking own gut lining. Mood: Protective with hidden danger.

cards.lore: Apoptosis is clean. Necrosis is inflammatory. Coagulative necrosis (ischemia) leaves ghost outlines. Liquefactive necrosis (brain/abscesses) causes enzymatic self-digestion.
cards.gradeReason: "Adaptation." is a noun, not an action. Four morphologies listed, zero invitation to perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Pathology textbook illustration. Subject: Cell in four simultaneous death poses — coagulative, liquefactive, caseous, fat. Mood: Cold clinical taxonomy.

cards.lore: Death that shouts. Pyroptosis: inflammasome → caspase-1 → IL-1β release via gasdermin pores. Gain-of-function NLRP3 mutations cause CAPS (treat with anakinra).
cards.gradeReason: "Death that shouts" is G1 writing but gasdermin-NLRP3-CAPS chain immediately buries it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Explosive inflammatory death. Subject: Cell exploding through gasdermin pores, shouting IL-1β cytokines in all directions. Mood: Loud programmed destruction.

cards.lore: Persistent TGF-β signaling activates Smad2/3 → fibroblast-to-myofibroblast transition → excessive architectural collagen (e.g., IPF, Cirrhosis). Pirfenidone blocks this pathway.
cards.gradeReason: "Rogue Healing" is a good villain concept but Smad2/3-myofibroblast chain explains not invites.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Overgrown factory. Subject: Spider weaving obsessive scar tissue over healthy lung with TGF-β silk thread. Mood: Relentless biological overbuilding.

cards.lore: Hallmarks include immune evasion, replicative immortality, and the Warburg effect (aerobic glycolysis). Tumors actively recruit M2 macrophages and Tregs to suppress the local immune response.
cards.gradeReason: "Ten Broken Rules" turns cancer hallmarks into a game — enumerate them all at the table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Rogue lawbreaker portrait. Subject: Octopus tumor systematically smashing ten immune rulebooks with Warburg glow. Mood: Anarchic immortal menace.

cards.lore: The ultimate quest: Every drug, mechanism, and pathology card interacts. If you give Anti-TNF to a RA patient, you disable Granny Granuloma. If you lack BTK, you lose Barb B-Cell.
cards.gradeReason: "Master Synthesis" meta-card is powerful for experienced players, bewildering for newcomers.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Wise professor portrait. Subject: Owl attending in white coat connecting entire immune web with case-study chalk lines. Mood: Authoritative clinical synthesis.

cards.lore: Anti-TNF (Infliximab/Adalimumab): TNF-α → RA, Crohn's, Psoriasis | Reactivates TB. JAK Inhibitor (Tofacitinib): JAK-STAT → RA, UC | Shingles (VZV) Reactivation. Anti-IL-17 (Secukinumab): IL-17A → Ankylosing Spondylitis | Worsens IBD. Anti-IL-4Rα (Dupilumab): Th2 Axis → Asthma, Atopic Derm | Eosinophilia (transient).
cards.gradeReason: Pure reference table — no character, no power, no invitation to perform anything.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro infographic. Subject: FrizzleBob rabbit in lab coat presenting biologic drug comparison matrix. Mood: Educational summary reference.

verdict: The Immunology & Pathology ADD deck is FrizzleBob's most medically comprehensive hit — 56 character cards covering innate immunity, adaptive immunity, autoimmune disease, and biologics with surgical precision and genuine theatrical flair. Top cards (Granny Granuloma, Betty B27's "can't see pee climb a tree," Rex Treg, Ana Anaphylaxis) are pure table theater. The bottom tier — particularly Card 51 and Card 56 — anchors in explanation-mode rather than invitation-mode. Fix the two G3s and this deck ships clean. Table-ready: Y.
blurb: 56 character cards covering immune cells, autoimmunity, and biologics — built for medical students who learn by performing, not memorizing. FrizzleBob makes immunology stick.
